environment.description: Same EKS pod in isolated processing subnet. S3 gateway VPC endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) configured with a restrictive endpoint policy that uses aws:PrincipalOrgID and explicit resource-level deny. The endpoint policy contains a default-deny with an allow only for s3:PutObject to arn:aws:s3:::prod-events-sink/* conditioned on StringEquals aws:PrincipalOrgID matching o-abc123def4 AND StringLike s3:prefix 'processed/*'. A second statement explicitly denies all S3 actions to any resource NOT matching arn:aws:s3:::prod-events-sink/processed/*. The pod's IAM role (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/kafka-processor-prod) has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/S3SinkOnlyBoundary) that limits s3:PutObject to arn:aws:s3:::prod-events-sink/processed/*. All S3 traffic from this subnet routes exclusively through this VPC endpoint (no internet gateway, no NAT, route table only has vpce and local routes).

config.route_table: only local (10.0.0.0/16) and vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 pl-63a5400a (S3 prefix list)
